| # | Bug | Root Cause | Fix |
|---|-----|-----------|-----|
| 1 | Child's `LangVersion`/`DefineConstants` silently overwritten | `<Import>` was *after* child property assignments, so parent ran second and clobbered them | Moved `<Import>` to the **top** of the child file |
| 2 | `DefineConstants` lost across layers | Parent unconditionally set `REPO_BUILD` without appending | Changed to `$(DefineConstants);REPO_BUILD` |
| 3 | Parent `NoWarn` (`NU1702`) lost | Child replaced instead of appending | Changed to `$(NoWarn);CS1591;IDE0005` |
| 4 | Cryptic AOT build errors on some machines | Unquoted condition `$(EnableAot) == true` — undefined property causes parse ambiguity | Quoted both sides: `'$(EnableAot)' == 'true'` |
| 5 | Output path segments run together | Backslash `artifacts\bin` isn't a separator on Linux | Changed to forward slash `artifacts/bin` |
